name: Motorcycle Simulator Louisiana
summary:
Ride New Orleans, Louisiana, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

16 KM ROUND NEW ORLEANS
East on I-610 past City Park and Gentilly, down Elysian Fields Avenue, then west on I-10 along the elevated Claiborne past the Treme, the Superdome and the downtown towers, north-west through Mid-City past Xavier and Carrollton, and back up Canal Boulevard to City Park.
